created_for: Startup Sim Godot facility placement and state feedback
storage_policy: Primary copy lives inside godot/StartupSimGodot/assets/art. External D:/美术资源/startup-sim copy is backup only.

source_tooling.post_processing: Pillow resize/crop to 1792x672, local chroma-key removal, sliced into individual icons
source_tooling.transparency: generated on #ff00ff chroma-key and converted to RGBA alpha

godot_import.suggested_usage: Sprite2D regions for placed facility state, placement preview, and upgrade feedback
godot_import.alternate_usage: Use individual PNGs from exports/icons when atlas slicing is not desired.

notes: The atlas and all 24 sliced icons are transparent RGBA PNGs.
Rows are aligned to the current G1 facility data layer.
No readable text, numbers, or UI labels are intended.
